ruleDefinitions.name: WMImplant Hack Tool
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects parameters used by WMImplant Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*WMImplant.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ change\\_user\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ gen\\_cli\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ command\\_exec\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ disable\\_wdigest\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ disable\\_winrm\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ enable\\_wdigest\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ enable\\_winrm\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ registry\\_mod\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ remote\\_posh\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ sched\\_job\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ service\\_mod\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ process\\_kill\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ active\\_users\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ basic\\_info\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ power\\_off\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ vacant\\_system\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ logon\\_events\\ .*"))
